prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a luxury beauty advertisement featuring the woman from the reference image, keeping her face exactly identical. She is styled in a premium fashion look with soft glowing skin, flawless makeup, and elegant hair flow. Background is minimal with soft gradient lighting. She is holding a high-end perfume bottle (inspired by Dior style). Add soft light reflections, glossy finish, premium branding aesthetic. Include text: "Timeless Beauty" and a subtle logo-style branding. Ultra-clean, commercial photography, 8K resolution.
